messages:
Ava (People Ops): Hi all — looping in on Sam's accommodation request. Sam, can you briefly outline what would help you in the office and any temporary schedule you're proposing?
Sam Lee: thanks. TL;DR: I have heat sensitivity & migraines. Being near the server room / central AC makes symptoms worse. Asking for: 1) ability to work remotely 3 days/week for 6 weeks while we trial office adjustments, 2) a desk fan + air purifier at my desk, 3) flexible start times on in-office days (~10am).
Daniel Chen (Eng Manager): thanks for sharing, Sam. I want to support you — my immediate concern is onboarding/mentorship for the new hires joining in two weeks. They rely on pair-programming in-office. Could we do remote 3 days but have you in-office Tues/Thurs for overlap?
Sam Lee: Tue/Thu in-office sounds reasonable. On in-office days I can try staggered hours. Remote days help a lot though — migraines are unpredictable.
Ava (People Ops): That works as a starting point. We'll document a 6-week trial: remote M/W/F, in-office Tue/Thu, flexible 10am start on in-office days. We'll check in weekly with Daniel and Sam; we'll use performance check-ins rather than formal PIP language.
Daniel Chen (Eng Manager): agreed. Proposal: weekly 30-min sync focused on ramp goals + pairing schedule. I'll also make sure new hires have async learning materials and scheduled pair sessions with other mentors if Sam is remote.
Priya (EEO): Quick note — ensure we keep accommodation details private and only share necessary info with direct manager and HR. Also offer Sam the option to decline disclosing medical specifics. This plan seems reasonable as an ADA accommodation.
HR Bot: Policy link: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/accommodations — team, please complete the "Temporary Accommodation Trial" form so we have dates and equipment requests logged.
Ava (People Ops): I'll submit the formal accommodation letter template today and add the desk fan + HEPA purifier to the office service ticket. Sam — can you confirm any equipment preferences (small/clip fan, noise level) and if you need an ergonomic chair?
Sam Lee: clip fan + quiet purifier would be great. I do use noise-cancelling headphones but might need a chair later. Thanks.
Daniel Chen (Eng Manager): noted. I'm happy to adjust pairings. Also, if remote days affect synchronous collaboration, I'll document expectations (response windows, scheduled async tasks).
Ava (People Ops): Next steps: 1) I'll send the formal trial confirmation + start/end dates, 2) Facilities will order fan/purifier, 3) Daniel and Sam will set weekly check-ins and share a short ramp goal doc. We'll reconvene after 6 weeks to evaluate.
Sam Lee: appreciated. Feeling relieved to have a plan. :relieved:
Priya (EEO): Thanks everyone. Please keep notes minimal and objective for the evaluation (dates, attendance, goal progress).
Ava (People Ops): Thanks — I'll post the confirmation and close the loop here. :thumbsup:
